nonnegative_weight_cone_obstruction.proof_reason: For nonnegative weights, phi-stationarity requires positive-sign weighted sin mass to equal negative-sign weighted sin mass. Omega-stationarity would then require their weighted mean d values to match. Positive-sign nodes lie in d=0..7 and negative-sign nodes lie in d=8..11, so the means cannot match unless all mass is zero.
